turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
Then start there. Yes or no.
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

So if I ask for the review your own procedure gives me, you go after his late work. I'm writing that down. The principal will hear it from me, word for word, and there is no committee anywhere in the procedure I printed.
Your call. No. It's yours, and you still haven't told me whether my son got to speak first. Show me what you have on that essay, or take the zero off.
